As the bus jostles along, she leans slightly toward you, her enthusiasm spilling over. “This place can be a little overwhelming at first,” she continues, her eyes sparkling with excitement, “but you’ll love it here! Everyone’s pretty cool, and there are so many activities to join.” She gestures animatedly, her hands punctuating her words. “Trust me, you’ll make friends in no time!”
